rows.note: This is the casual all-purpose way to describe someone keeping an eye on an activity or person.

example.english: The supervision of the children keeps the whole activity running smoothly.
example.traditional: 有人睇住班細路，成個活動先順利。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 tai2 zyu6 baan1 sai3 lou6 seng4 go3 wut6 dung6 sin1 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Use this for responsible or organized oversight, especially when the supervision is an official duty; it also covers the more formal slice of sense 0.

example.english: A teacher must be responsible for the supervision in the laboratory.
example.traditional: 實驗室一定要有老師負責監督。
example.jyutping: sat6 jim6 sat1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 lou5 si1 fu6 zaak3 gaam1 duk1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a tutorial session with an individual student or small group.

example.english: I have a supervision session next week to discuss a report with a few classmates.
example.traditional: 我下星期有一堂導修課，要同幾個同學傾份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 jat1 tong4 dou6 sau1 fo3 jiu3 tung4 gei2 go3 tung4 hok6 king1 fan2 bou3 gou3
